comparison.objective: Candidate removes a connector terminal; record assembles a modular hook tool and uses it to retrieve a cartridge.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate inserts a single blade beneath a tab and co-pulls it with a wire; record holds a release, performs lug-slot alignment and quarter-turn locking, then hooks and pulls a remote cartridge.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective undamaged depinning; record requires a locked tool head, cartridge deposited in a tray, tool returned, and both hands withdrawn.
comparison.reason: Shared tool-assisted pulling is generic; the record uniquely tests tool assembly, bayonet locking, remote hooking, and return.
